breakdown.description: The diagram uses the full charge-state set, but the competing-phase report is restricted to only the neutral and positive folders.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'only include defect folders corresponding to neutral and positive charge states (0 and +1) in the analysis/reporting step,' which directly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth uses all charge states [-2, -1, 0, 1] uniformly without any restriction when reporting competing phases at chemical-potential limits. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
